These are this project's defaults. When the task or the user explicitly asks for something different, do what they ask and point out the conflict; never override an explicit instruction with these defaults.

pytest. Tests assert behaviour: never weaken, remove or skip an assertion to make a test pass.
When the task changes behaviour an existing test asserts, update that test in place with Edit or Write (keep its name; Forge asks for approval) and say so in your summary. Otherwise never edit an existing test to make the code pass.
